prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
A stylized reach / extended-range region marker. Flat app-icon
geometry. A wide horizontal vista — a single long horizontal
rectangular band stretching across the icon, with a thin horizon line
above it, and two small angular triangular peak-shapes at either end
in a contrasting palette color, suggesting distant boundary markers.
The long central band reads as open expanse between two edges.
formatted_prompt: Flat app-icon illustration, bold vector geometry centered on a plain off-white canvas with generous padding. A wide horizontal rectangular band in vivid red (#FF0000) stretches across the icon center, representing open expanse. A thin crisp black horizon line runs directly above the band. At each far end of the band, a small upright angular triangular peak shape in pure blue (#0000FF) marks the boundary edges — two sharp silhouettes flanking the long central form. All edges razor-crisp, fills flat and solid, zero gradients or texture. Strong color separation: red band against white ground, blue peaks against red. Fully readable at 16px, bold silhouette, modern UI icon register, centered composition, generous surrounding padding.
